final: SELECT AVG(p), AVG(r) FROM (SELECT AVG(s.pressratio) AS p, AVG(s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin) AS r FROM scans s JOIN sites t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.typesite)
